# Tech stack

- Frontend: React 19, React Router 7, Vite 8, Axios, Lucide React, Vitest, Testing Library, Oxlint.
- Backend: Python FastAPI with SQLAlchemy and Pydantic schemas.
- AI/data integrations present in the repository: LangGraph-style agent services, Groq/Ollama providers, ChromaDB, and Neo4j client code.
- Frontend runtime configuration: `VITE_API_BASE_URL`, defaulting to `http://localhost:8000`.
- Authentication: bearer token stored in browser localStorage under `cv_token`.
- The reference archive uses React/TypeScript/Vite and a shadcn-style primitive collection; its useful transferable evidence is the chapter navigation and editorial visual language.
